The answer is 2021: the first mouse-eradication operation on Gough Island was the attempt that year, after the 2020 operation was cancelled by COVID-19 travel restrictions. The team note's options don't fit the record. Its 2019 date was only a planned start, and its claim of baiting soon after a quick feasibility study is wrong, since the feasibility study was published in 2008. I found no source for a 2011 start. Sources differ on whether the programme's start counts as 2020 or 2021, which is why my confidence is moderate.

CONFIDENCE: 65
